about: Each case runs heuristicTriage(input) and checks that the result contains `expected`. `assertions` say why the case exists.

evals.name: existing-kind-label-wins
assertions: A matching label beats every keyword rule and is kept as-is

evals.name: p0-label-is-critical
assertions: Priority labels like P0 mean critical

evals.name: empty-body-needs-info
assertions: A nearly empty report is NEEDS_INFO even if the title sounds like a bug

evals.name: short-question-is-not-needs-info

input.title: How do I configure the token?

assertions: A title ending in ? skips the empty-body rule
Questions are judged on the title

evals.name: security-is-critical

input.title: Security hole in auth middleware
input.body: An attacker can bypass the login check by sending an empty token header.

assertions: The word security makes it critical, checked before plain bugs

input.title: Export fails on large files
input.body: Steps to reproduce: 1. open a 2GB file 2. click export. Expected behaviour: the file is saved.

evals.name: feature-request

input.title: Add an option to export CSV
input.body: It would be great to download the table as CSV for monthly reporting.

assertions: 'Add an option' asks for new behaviour

evals.name: question-mark-in-body-is-not-a-question

input.title: Thoughts on the roadmap
input.body: I have been using this project for a while. Is the plugin system still planned? Would love to know.

assertions: A ? in the body must not make an issue a question
No signal falls back to needs-triage at low confidence
